title: Coherence across codimension-two boundaries on Nagata universally catenary schemes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof normalizes the integral supports at associated points and uses finiteness of normalization. It then proves depth at least two along the boundary using normality and the dimension formula, so that the normalized coherent sheaf satisfies a Hartogs extension theorem. The normalization-and-depth construction is the nonroutine content.
